nom: Vanicream Moisturizing Cream with Pump Dispenser

segments.oily: The few reviewers who describe skin that also gets oily found the cream light rather than greasy and reported no new breakouts, though one still describes her skin as dehydrated despite the oiliness.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry to extremely dry skin, including eczema- and psoriasis-prone skin, report the thick cream relieves flaking and cracking, though one reviewer with extremely dry, mature skin saw no visible change.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers describe sensitive, reactive or allergy-prone skin and report no burning, stinging or breakouts from this fragrance-free formula; a minority instead had their skin react with redness, itching or peeling.
segments.normal: One reviewer describing normal, sensitive skin found it ineffective and disliked a sour smell, while another with normal-to-dry skin has used it daily for three years without irritation.
segments.mature: One reviewer with mature, older skin reports no visible improvement in smoothness or moisture after several applications.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry, extremely dry or eczema-prone skin consistently report the thick cream relieves flaking, cracking and tightness, often within days; a couple describe no improvement or, in one case, feeling drier with peeling skin after facial use.
concerns.redness: Reviewers using it for reactive, rosacea-prone or previously irritated skin report calmer, less red skin with no burning; one reviewer instead developed redness and itching around her mouth and eyes.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers repairing a compromised skin barrier, including from acne medication or tretinoin use, report visible calming and reduced breakouts within about two days of use.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone or breakout-prone skin mostly report the cream does not clog pores or trigger new breakouts, with some describing existing breakouts calming down; one reviewer with sensitive, acne-prone skin did not find it effective for that concern.

aspects.libelle: Absorbs without greasy residue despite thick texture
Feels heavy or too thick in hot weather
Packaging often arrives broken or leaking
Pump doesn't fully empty the jar
Long-lasting, strong value for the size

extraits.texte: I have used the Daily Facial Moisturizer for my sensitive skin with no issues so I figured this Cream would be similar. I was diagnosed with Perioral dermatitis during my last pregnancy and if I’m not careful it gets triggered. I knew this cream would be thicker and planned to use at bedtime specifically. Unfortunately, my skin couldn’t agree with the cream. I had redness and severe itching on my face, around my mouth, chin and my eyes. The formula itself felt quite sticky when applying. Unfortunately I gave it to my daughter and her skin immediately reacted the same having redness and itching when applied.

So I have extremely dry skin and have been lathering this on and have not seen much of a change. It is thick but spreads well. I put this on my face and all over hands and arms. I have even applied it directly out of the shower as you're supposed to when you're using lotions. It may be an accumulated softening I don't know but at this point I'm not seeing much change in my skin. It is non fragrance which is great because there's a lot of mosquitoes where I am. Mosquitoes and bees and things are all attracted to scent. I did like the fact that for this price point you get a very nice big jar. Pump works great I'm having no problems with it. I just don't see this working on mature, older skin like mine. I have attached a picture after three applications to my hand. You can clearly see that it has not smoothed the area, nor moisturized it the way that all the other reviewers have claimed. I did purchase this based on all the five star reviews and this is a very honest opinion of how I feel about this product.

extraits.titre: THE BEST FOR SENSITIVE/ACNE PRONE SKIN
extraits.texte: I ordered this cream when my skin barrier was in serious need of repair. I have extremely sensitive, reactive, acne prone skin so I need to be really diligent in making sure a products ingredient list doesn't contain too many irritants (i.e fragrance, drying alcohols). I've used other vanicream products before (i.e. gentle face wash, lite lotion) and absolutely love them. Their ingredient list is pretty boring and there's nothing in there that will really do anything for your skin, but that's what I love about vanicream. These are the products I reach for when my skin is really going through it. Plus, it doesn't cause any new breakouts or irritate any existing breakouts that I already have, which is a major plus! I've even found that when I put this on at night that my skin and breakouts looks so much more calm in the morning. When I bought this cream I thought I would only be using it for when my skin was extremely dehydrated and needed to be nourished and repaired. But I found that even after my skin barrier was repaired, which only took 2 days of using this cream, I was still reaching for it. My skin still gets pretty oily but because of the acne medications I used to take, my skin is really dehydrated. This cream is super nourishing and thick but it blends in so easily and it doesn't feel too heavy. I also really love this so much more than the Cerave moisturizing cream. extraits.titre: Fantastic under makeup! No pilling!!! Saved my tretinoin irritated skin within 2 days
extraits.texte: I threw away my expensive products and switched to Vanicream moisturizing cream and the gentle cleanser and my skin looks incredible. I’m 35 and started tretinoin 2 months ago. Despite using the lowest dose, starting slow, and doing the sandwich method, my skin was burning everytime I’d apply any moisturizer. I read that vanicream is so gentle that it would be a good product to pair with retinol and man I wish I switched sooner. I had awful breakouts probably from a damaged skin barrier and within 2 days of vanicream my skin cleared up!!!! I use this on my face and have incredibly acne prone and sensitive skin even at 35 and this has improved my skin in just a week!!! Sometimes those expensive products with all the fancy ingredients are junk!!! And simpler is better. I was worried it would be too thick and make my face greasy but my face has been so balanced using this product! It does not pill and layers beautiful on top of serums and tretinoin gel. My spf layers nicely on top of this with no issues. It gives my face a beautifully moisturized foundation for an even makeup application. I will buy this forever!!!

extraits.titre: I am so impressed and so happy with my purchase
extraits.texte: I have been searching for a product that would moisturize my skin. I am an African American woman with dry, scaly skin. I have tried St Ives lotions, body shop body butter, and have even made my own whipped shea and cocoa butter cream. I was diagnosed with a mild form of eczema when I was younger, and I used to be able to apply light moisturizers to my skin until about last year. I was having difficulty sleeping, because my hands, feet and back felt so dry. I would wake up in the middle of the night to apply more lotion, because the texture of the blankets made my skin feel even more dry. I looked up products on Amazon and YouTube and decided to give this a try. The product was smaller than I expected. I was expecting a bigger container, but a little really goes a long way. I usually pile a lot of moisturizers on my skin, but I didn't need to with this product. I am so impressed and so happy with my purchase. This should be a staple product for anyone with extremely dry and itchy skin.

extraits.titre: A moisturizer that finally works when everything else failed!
extraits.texte: Finally a moisturizer that doesn’t burn Sting or irritate my skin. I’ve had supersensitive skin all my life especially on my face and I am 46 years old I have finally found the one lotion that doesn’t irritate my face. The picture I added is a picture of what happens with every other lotion that supposedly is for sensitive skin as you can see those other products did not work those other products did not work. I am day two into using the cleanser and the moisturizer and you have no idea how great it is for my face not to burn and turn bright red just fantastic!!!! The moisturizer is a bit thick so you don’t need a lot even though it’s a little higher priced it’ll last forever and it’s worth it when you have supersensitive skin. FAN FOR LIFE!!!

I have been using this cream for about 1-2 years. This was my first time buying the huge tub. I have very sensitive skin, redness, acne prone, oily. This is the only cream I’ve ever used that does not make me red and it clears my break outs within 1-2 days without any direct spot treatment. I highly recommend this cream, my dermatologist also talks highly of this product. Ingredients are clean and not harmful, which is my priority. I used this as my main cream before my wedding and my skin was flawless!
